what_this_is: The p = 2^31 - 1 calibration curve of docs/ic/research/fp_p31_subexp_calibration_20261121 (fp_p31_subexp_mersenne_instance). Values are copied from that directory's committed CURVE.json; the name is the legacy handle docs/ic/calibration.json pins as prime/generated-31bit-2147483647, recorded here so the registry and src/cryptanalysis/curve_aliases.json keep resolving it. The order was checked on 2026-11-24: 2147487637 is prime and annihilates the generator, and it is the only multiple of that order in the Hasse interval.
name: generated-31bit-2147483647
